slides.texte_overlay:
the tiny rule that makes you
smarter every single month

learn before you scroll

the rule is simple: learn one real thing before you allow yourself any feed. five minutes of learning first quietly turns every day into a small step forward.

write it in one line

after you learn it, write it down in one sentence. if you can't fit it in one line, you haven't understood it yet, and that's the part worth going back to.

tell someone about it

share what you learned with one person the same day. teaching it once is what moves an idea from short term memory into something you'll still know in a year.

stack it daily

do it every day for a month with a short lesson on history, art or science. thirty tiny lessons is more new knowledge than most people pick up in an entire year.
slides.texte_sophia:
stack it daily

do it every day with one short lesson on history, art or science. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and thirty lessons beat what most people learn in a year.

slides.texte_overlay:
review on sundays

every sunday, reread your one line notes from the week. a two minute review is the whole difference between learning something and actually remembering it later.
